summary: 50-year-old man overdue from a Monday hike up Silver Creek Trail; car and belongings found at trailhead the next day. Located seriously injured after phone contact; Blackhawk from Buckley AFB inserted two Alpine Rescue Team members ~4:45 p.m. Tuesday and he was evacuated ~5:30 p.m. by Flight for Life to a hospital, recovering.
responding_agency: Clear Creek County Sheriff's Office, Clear Creek EMS, Clear Creek Fire Authority, Alpine Rescue Team, Flight for Life Colorado, Buckley AFB Blackhawk
notes: Source: KKTV 2024-10-15. Incident date 2024-10-14 (Monday the man hiked, reported overdue the next day).
